name: NEXTDC S3 Sydney (Artarmon)
notes: NEXTDC official page lists S3 Sydney at Artarmon (Willoughby LGA) delivering more than 20,000 sqm of IT space and 80MW of critical power; Multiplex completed Stage 1 and later Stage 2 of the nine-level facility at 2 Broadcast Way, Artarmon, and Architectus records S3 at 80MW/10,800 racks. Capacity is the official critical-power figure for the facility.

name: Goodman Artarmon Data Centre (Project EOS)
notes: Goodman received approval for a State Significant Development (SSD) application to construct and operate a large-scale data centre at 2-8 Lanceley Place and 14 Campbell Street, Artarmon (Willoughby LGA); Urban Digest reported the ~A$845m project, Ason Group's Project EOS case study cites 80MVA power capacity, and AreaSearch lists the project as 'Approved'. capacity_mw left null because the 80MVA is a grid-import/connection figure, not IT load.

name: Equinix SY7 Unanderra (formerly Metronode Illawarra 1/2)
notes: Equinix SY7 (ex-Metronode Illawarra 1) is a modular prefabricated data centre at 8 Lathe Place / Lot 102 Lathe Place, Unanderra in Wollongong LGA; Metronode also opened a second Wollongong facility in November 2017, both acquired by Equinix in 2018. Recorded as one Wollongong campus; capacity not publicly disclosed.

name: Project Ares (Murranji Station)
notes: Energy North proposes Project Ares, a 1GW hyperscale off-grid AI data centre campus on Murranji Station (19,150 ha, ~90 ha of data halls) in the Barkly Region, powered by gas, solar and battery infrastructure with water from the Montejinni Limestone Aquifer. NT EPA consultation was open from 8 Jul 2026 following submission of an EPBC referral; ABC (1 Jul 2026) and DCD report the proposal. Status = announced/under federal environmental assessment; 1GW is proposed total IT capacity, not built.

name: NEXTDC D1 Darwin
notes: NEXTDC D1 Darwin at 2 Harvey Street, Darwin CBD is a 7+MW Tier IV-designed data centre officially opened 14 August 2024 (~A$80m investment, ~2,000 sqm mission critical space, target 7MW/1,000 racks); developed in partnership with the NT Government and Vocus. Capacity is official target critical capacity.

name: NEXTDC D2 Darwin
notes: NEXTDC D2 Darwin is a 6MW AI-ready, seven-level data centre in Darwin CBD (2-8 Ryko Court site per directory listings) with four data halls, six generators and six cooling towers; NEXTDC official page lists it as in development, DCD reported the topping out on 9 March 2026, and completion is targeted for 1H FY27.

name: Beetaloo Digital Weddell AI Data Centre & Energy Mega-Campus
developer: Beetaloo Digital Pty Ltd (Beetaloo Energy subsidiary)
notes: Beetaloo Digital was granted a 12-month exclusive commitment by the NT Government over a 185-hectare site at Weddell (Litchfield LGA, ~30km SE of Darwin) to develop a claimed ~A$40bn, ~2GW AI data centre and energy mega-campus powered by gas from the Beetaloo Basin (two gas-fired power stations proposed). Status = announced/early (land exclusivity, feasibility and regulatory approvals pending); 2GW is the proponent's ultimate campus claim, not built capacity. Official NT Government Territory Coordinator page (5 Aug 2026) confirms the land commitment.
